The child's other hand points directly at the fossil, eyes widen with delighted realization and mouth slightly opens at the instant of discovery. Main visual chain must be clear: formerly hidden object, covering stone just moved, new object now revealed, instant finding reaction. Keep everything close together. No magnifying glass or map, no searching in progress, no simply looking at scenery.
